recommendation.evidence_policy: lookup-v2; last 2*max(3,minimum_repeats) runs; adjacent-block drift gate; mean +/- 3 standard errors, not a predictive interval

driver_failure.cause: Client hashed the response including its digest field; server correctly rejected it.
driver_failure.recovery: Used server-provided digest on the same saved recommendation. No compute attempt replay.

limits: One model, one batch-one configuration, no cross-device ranking or speedup claim.
Same100 images per Job; four Jobs are timing replicates, not400 independent accuracy samples.
NPU utilization, NPU memory and power are unknown. Host RSS is the memory gate.
S3/API/MLflow equality is a recorded live read-back assertion; private storage locations are not published.
Recommendation interval is a mean uncertainty interval, not a future-Job prediction guarantee.
